name: Text area
purpose: Ask for a few sentences, such as a description, a reason, or a note.
description: A labelled multiline field. With a length limit it counts characters as a person types, and the browser enforces the limit.

label.description: What the field asks for. It names the control and, with no name prop, the key its value is sent under.

name.description: The key the value is sent under, such as "email". Left out, it is the label in camelCase: "Work email" is sent as workEmail.

placeholder.description: An example of an answer, shown until a person types.

maxLength.description: Most characters a person can enter. Set, it is counted under the field.

required.description: The form cannot be sent until a person fills this in.

hint.description: Help that stays under the field and is read with it, such as a format or a limit.

error.description: A problem with the value, shown under the field and announced with it. It marks the field invalid.
